description: MainFragment class for an Android app managing notes, including UI setup, navigation, and interactions with attachments, camera, and audio recording.

classes.name: MainFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment managing the main notes UI, including navigation, attachment handling, and user interactions.

methods.name: actionToEditor
methods.description: Creates navigation directions to the editor screen with specified note ID, attachments, and list mode.

methods.name: actionToSearch
methods.description: Creates navigation directions to the search screen with an optional query.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles click events on notes, navigating to the editor.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click events on notes, showing a menu.

methods.name: onSelectionChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on selection state.

methods.name: onLayoutModeChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when layout mode changes.

methods.name: onSortMethodChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when sort method changes.
